notes: the chain through Ma'mar ends with the saying («فرآني أبو لبابة أو زيد») and names no Companion
the second chain (صالح ... الزهري ... ابن عمر) is a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
«وتابعه» names followers of Abd al-Razzaq: a mutabaʿa remark, a variant group
